releases.name: landstrip 0.20.18
releases.body:
Landstrip 0.20.18

landstrip:
- extensions: deduplicate formatted and streamed trap errors (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: windows: deduplicate ACL grants and cache StateStore DACL (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: windows: split win32, acl, and process modules from mod.rs (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: seccomp: replace NotificationSyscalls with SyscallClass (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: seccomp: unify Unix socket connect and bind broker paths (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: seccomp: unify path and fd metadata mutation grants (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: linux: extract Subreaper and ProcFd from seccomp process (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: resolver: cache write-anchor and symlink-ancestor stats (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: policy: group read and write denials into DenialScope (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: platform: split policy validation from resolution and probes (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: config: preserve typed policy I/O and parse context (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: error: extract PolicyViolation and drop sentinel variants (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: glob: fast-path literal prefixes and reuse memo buffer (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: paths: drop redundant stat in canonicalize_existing_prefix (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

opencode-landstrip:
- Bump the version to 0.20.18 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

pi-landstrip:
- Bump the version to 0.20.18 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- pi-landstrip: ignore worker write traps on protectedPaths (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- extensions: deduplicate formatted and streamed trap errors (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

Signed-off-by: Jarkko Sakkinen <jarkko.sakkinen@iki.fi>

releases.name: landstrip 0.20.16
releases.body:
Landstrip 0.20.16

landstrip:
- landstrip: macos: remove redundant borrow in carveout ancestor check (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- scripts: move macOS SDK between hosts via container image (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: package: auto-detect SDKROOT from target/sdk (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: tests: do not redirect stderr to /dev/null without write grant (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: preserve path separator in canonical glob spellings (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: macos: log rendered Seatbelt profile at debug level (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- build(deps-dev): bump oxlint in /packages/pi-landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- build(deps): bump libc from 0.2.190 to 0.2.191 in /packages/landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- landstrip-api: add scoped grant calculations and refine sessionScopeFor (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: support dynamic allowWrite and allowRead glob carveouts (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: tests: refactor test probes into Probe trait implementations (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

opencode-landstrip:
- Bump the version to 0.20.16 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- build(deps): bump @opentui/core in /packages/opencode-landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- opencode-landstrip: support unix socket persistence and scoped denyWrite grants (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

pi-landstrip:
- Bump the version to 0.20.16 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- build(deps-dev): bump oxlint in /packages/pi-landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- build(deps-dev): bump oxfmt in /packages/pi-landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- build(deps-dev): bump vitest in /packages/pi-landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- build(deps-dev): bump typebox in /packages/pi-landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- build(deps-dev): bump the pi-sdk group (dependabot[bot])
- pi-landstrip: fix permission persistence for denyWrite globs and unix sockets (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

Signed-off-by: Jarkko Sakkinen <jarkko.sakkinen@iki.fi>

releases.name: landstrip 0.20.15
releases.body:
Landstrip 0.20.15

landstrip:
- landstrip-api: parse bare relative bash redirect denials (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- extensions: prompt and allow overrides for soft denyWrite (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: let more specific allowWrite carve out denyWrite (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip-api: drop positional and config-object overloads (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip-api: sync trap mechanisms and internal policy codes (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- scripts: drop unused binary receipt helpers from sha256.sh (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: split policy resolution into a separate submodule (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: encapsulate deny matching into DenyRuleSet (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: modularize glob pattern engine into paths::glob (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: consolidate path normalization and queries into PathExt (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- package: discover imported release outputs by default (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

opencode-landstrip:
- Bump the version to 0.20.15 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- extensions: prompt and allow overrides for soft denyWrite (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- opencode-landstrip: drop legacy OpenCode v1 shims and re-exports (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip-api: drop positional and config-object overloads (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip-api: sync trap mechanisms and internal policy codes (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

pi-landstrip:
- Bump the version to 0.20.15 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- pi-landstrip: accept macOS denial wording in bash test (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- pi-landstrip: keep denied bash trap diagnostics and skip re-prompt (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- extensions: prompt and allow overrides for soft denyWrite (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- pi-landstrip: drop legacy config, frontmatter, and module shims (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- pi-landstrip: remove legacy /landstrip command and kill alias (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip-api: drop positional and config-object overloads (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

Signed-off-by: Jarkko Sakkinen <jarkko.sakkinen@iki.fi>
